title: Best-Selling Albums
subtitle: The best-selling albums of all time, ranked by claimed worldwide sales — replayed across a decade of Wikipedia's evolving list.

cityPreview.summary: All-time best-selling albums ranked by claimed worldwide sales, with real rank movement reconstructed from Wikipedia's annual Wayback Machine captures.

sourceStatus: Wikipedia current best-selling albums table, over Wayback Machine annual history
confidence: Live Wikipedia 'List of best-selling albums' table observed 2026-09-01T08:03:08.299Z, appended to real annual history reconstructed from Wayback Machine captures (2010-2025). Values are editors' claimed worldwide sales in millions of copies.
methodology: The adapter reconstructs one ranking frame per year from archived Wikipedia captures (checked-in backfill) and appends a freshly fetched current-year frame from the live Wikipedia table. Each frame ranks albums by claimed worldwide sales (millions); rank movement reflects real editorial revisions and list churn over time. Artist portraits are pulled from Wikipedia and packed into the WebP sprite atlas.

notes: Frames reconstructed from one Internet Archive capture of the Wikipedia 'List of best-selling albums' page per year, 2010-2025.
value = editors' claimed worldwide sales in millions. Rank movement is real: e.g. Thriller's claimed figure was revised 110M (2010-12) -> 51M (2013-15) -> 65-70M (2016-25).
Each frame shows the top ~20 albums by claimed sales; 25 distinct albums appear across the frames, so entityLimit is set to 25 to keep older frames populated and fill a clean 5x5 sprite atlas.
